scientific_integrity: Direct block-multiplication proof and explicit rank counting; finite independent enumeration corroborates but does not prove the asymptotic. Classical Gaussian rank count and existing sequential random-complex law explicitly credited.
scientific_limitations: Exact count for equal-sized three-level complete posets over fields of characteristic two; limits for fixed field order; no conjugacy classification. Overlap risk from more general treatments of varieties of complexes; no independent mathematical verification.
title: A two-parity rank law for square-one units in three-level incidence algebras
